name: overnight_vol_carry_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when today's overnight gap exceeds 1.5x the rolling average overnight gap (~15-20 spot pts vs the ~10 pt average), it typically reflects FII front-running in SGX Nifty that overshoots. By 09:25-09:30, these positions start unwinding — market makers who absorbed the opening imbalance flip short/long against the gap, creating predictable 20-40 spot pt mean-reversion pressure through the morning. Conversely, when NIFTY opens within 0.3x of its average overnight gap (a near-flat open with <3 pt gap), no overnight event absorbed directional order flow, so institutional algo desks accumulate in one direction from 09:20, manifesting as 30-minute momentum bursts. At 5-second resolution, the overnight ratio serves as a daily regime classifier; RSI(36) and EMA crossovers on 5-second bars then time precise 60-90 second entries within the regime's expected direction.

indicators.name: overnight_gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Daily measure computed once per session from the first and last bars of adjacent trading days. No 12x scaling — this is a session-level ratio, frequency-agnostic.

indicators.name: avg_overnight_gap
indicators.purpose: Rolling average of overnight gaps across all available days in spot_df. The more days available, the more stable the baseline. Minimum 2 days required.

indicators.name: overnight_ratio
indicators.purpose: Normalised daily gap magnitude. >1.5 = overshoot → mean-reversion regime; <0.3 = under-shoot → momentum regime; between = no trade.

indicators.name: gap_direction
indicators.purpose: Determines which direction to fade (mean-rev regime) or follow (momentum regime). Daily constant.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI. Original used RSI(14) on 1-min bars (14 minutes of data). We compress to 3 minutes because: (1) we hold 60-90s, not 60-240 min; (2) 3-min RSI detects bar-level overbought/oversold without lag; (3) the mean-reversion thesis fires quickly or not at all within 30s of a micro-spike.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute EMA. Micro-trend direction. In the momentum regime, close > ema_12 confirms upward pressure; in the mean-reversion regime, close < ema_12 after a gap-up confirms the rollover has begun.

indicators.name: ema_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute EMA. Context filter for the momentum regime: ema_12 > ema_36 signals sustained bullish institutional flow, ema_12 < ema_36 signals sustained bearish pressure. Original used EMA(9)/EMA(21) on 1-min bars (~9/21 min context). We use 1-min/3-min because our trade horizon is 60-90s, not 60-240 min — the context window shrinks proportionally.

conditions: mean_rev regime (overnight_ratio > high_ratio_threshold) AND gap was DOWN (gap_direction < 0) AND RSI(36) < 35 AND close > ema_12
momentum regime (overnight_ratio < low_ratio_threshold) AND ema_12 > ema_36 AND RSI(36) > 45 AND RSI(36) < 65
buy_ce.confirmation: Both EMA and RSI conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

conditions: mean_rev regime (overnight_ratio > high_ratio_threshold) AND gap was UP (gap_direction > 0) AND RSI(36) > 65 AND close < ema_12
momentum regime (overnight_ratio < low_ratio_threshold) AND ema_12 < ema_36 AND RSI(36) < 55 AND RSI(36) > 35
buy_pe.confirmation: Both EMA and RSI conditions must hold simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). In the mean-reversion regime, if NIFTY moves a further 10 pts against the fade, the overshoot is likely fundamental (news continuation) not microstructure — thesis is falsified. In the momentum regime, 10 spot pts pullback against a low-vol momentum session is too deep for a valid continuation.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points (~16 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). Mean-reversion bounces from high-gap NIFTY openings typically recover 20-40 spot pts in 30-60 minutes; a 16 pt move in the first 60-90 seconds captures the initial institutional unwind leg. Momentum regime targeting the same 16 pts is conservative (full momentum burst is 25-35 pts) but achievable within 90-120s.

filters.vix_filter: none — the overnight ratio implicitly captures overnight VIX impact; explicit VIX filter rejected to keep signal clean
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; mean-rev regime signals concentrated in 09:20-10:30; momentum regime can fire all day
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is inherently aggregated and less noisy than individual stocks
filters.trend_filter: daily regime classifier (overnight_ratio) acts as the macro trend/regime filter; EMA crossover is the micro-trend filter
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — the overnight/intraday vol relationship on NIFTY is structurally driven by SGX Nifty arbitrage and FII positioning patterns; edge weakens if FII participation structure changes significantly

adaptation_notes: Original traded NIFTY 50 constituent stocks at 1-min bars with 60-240 min holds. Three fundamental changes: (1) Universe collapsed to NIFTY INDEX — the overnight gap logic applies equally well to NIFTY itself (SGX Nifty drives NIFTY opens the same way global markets drive individual stocks); (2) Hold time compressed from 60-240 min to 60-120 seconds — the overnight ratio becomes a daily REGIME FILTER, not a trade target; 5-second RSI/EMA signals provide precise micro-timing within the regime's expected direction; (3) ATR-based stops replaced with fixed option premium points — ATR of the index over 5s bars is ~0.2 pts, meaningless at option premium level; 5pt stop calibrated to typical NIFTY 90-second move magnitudes instead.
weaknesses: On ~50% of trading days, overnight_ratio falls in the neutral band (0.3-1.5), generating no regime signal — strategy fires only on days with extreme or flat overnight gaps
The mean-reversion vs momentum classification is binary; NIFTY sometimes exhibits hybrid behaviour (opens high but continues trending rather than reverting)
Rolling average overnight gap computed from the available spot_df days (typically ~12 days in backtesting) may be insufficient to establish a stable baseline; real deployment needs 20+ days
Momentum regime signals later in the day (post-11:00) may be weaker as the 'pent-up energy' thesis only applies in the morning session when overnight flow gets absorbed
